layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Abstract. The detection of curvilinear structures in medical images,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: e.g., blood vessels or nerve fibers, is important in aiding management of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: many diseases. In this work, we propose a general unifying curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: structure segmentation network that works on different medical imaging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: modalities: optical coherence tomography angiography (OCT-A), color

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fundus image, and corneal confocal microscopy (CCM). Instead of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: U-Net based convolutional neural network, we propose a novel network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (CS-Net) which includes a self-attention mechanism in the encoder and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder. Two types of attention modules are utilized - spatial attention

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and channel attention, to further integrate local features with their global

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dependencies adaptively. The proposed network has been validated on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: five datasets: two color fundus datasets, two corneal nerve datasets and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one OCT-A dataset. Experimental results show that our method out-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performs state-of-the-art methods, for example, sensitivities of corneal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nerve fiber segmentation were at least 2% higher than the competitors.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As a complementary output, we made manual annotations of two corneal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nerve datasets which have been released for public access.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Keywords: Curvilinear structure · Segmentation · Encoder and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1 Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Accurate detection of curvilinear structures, such as retinal vasculature from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: color fundus image [1], optical coherence tomography angiography (OCT-A),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and corneal nerve fiber from corneal confocal microscopy (CCM), are essen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tial for many clinical applications [2]. Manual labeling the curvilinear struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures is an exhausting, subjective and tedious tasks for human operators, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: practically impossible in high-throughput analysis settings like screening pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: grams or high-throughput microscopy. In consequence, an automatic segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation method for general curvilinear structures is indispensable to overcome

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time constraints, scale-up to big data analysis, and avoid human error. However,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: computer-aided systems under development have yet to solve the segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: problems as posed by high anatomical variation across the population, and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: varying scales of curvilinear structures within an image. Noise, poor contrast

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and low resolution, exacerbate these problems.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Extensive work has been carried out towards automatic vessel segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion or fiber tracing (see [3] for extensive review). As vasculatures or fibers are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structures distributed across different orientations and scales, various

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: filtering methods have been proposed, include Hessian matrix-based filters [4],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: symmetry filter [2], and tensor-based filter [5], to name only the most widely

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used ones. These approaches aim to remove undesired intensity variations in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image, and suppress background structures and image noise, thereby easing the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: subsequent segmentation problem. Recently, several deep learning-based meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods have been proposed for vessel segmentation and nerve fiber tracing in color

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fundus and CCM, respectively. Liskowski et al. [6] introduced a retinal vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: segmentation method based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and Fu

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: et al. [7] further applied the CNN along with Conditional Random Field to detect

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: retinal vessels. Alom et al. [8] adopted recurrent residual convolution block as the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: backbone of the U-shaped network (R2U-Net) to segment the vessels. Colonna et

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: al. [9] used the U-Net-based CNN [10] to trace the corneal nerve. However, deep

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: learning-based method has yet to be used to segment retinal vessels in OCT-A.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Most of these models were designed for segmentation of vessels or fibers from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specific biomedical imaging modalities. In this work, we proposed a Channel and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Spatial Attention Network (CS-Net) based on U-Net that has proven to be effec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tive to extract curvilinear structures from three biomedical imaging modalities.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This paper makes four contributions: (1) a new segmentation method was pro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: posed with self-attention mechanism; (2) CS-Net can deal with multiple types of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structure segmentation in a unified manner; (3) results on 5 datasets

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrate state-of-the-art performance; (4) we made manual annotations of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two corneal nerve datasets which have been released for public access.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2 Proposed Method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The proposed CS-Net consists of three phases: the encoder module, the channel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and spatial attention module (CSAM), and the decoder module, as shown in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig. 1. The feature encoder module includes four encoder blocks, and the resid-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ual network (ResNet) block was employed as the backbone for each block, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: then followed by a max-pooling layer to increase the receptive field for better

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extraction of global features. Then the features from the encoder are fed into

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig. 1. CS-Net structure diagram. It comprises of three phases: the feature encoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module, the channel and spatial attention module and the feature decoder module.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Color figure online)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two parallel attention blocks - the channel attention block (CAB) and a spatial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention block (SAB), as shown in the red and blue rectangles in Fig. 1. Finally,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the decoder module was used to reconstruct depth feature.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1 Spatial Attention Module

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Many recent works have shown the local feature representation produced

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by traditional fully convolutional networks (FCNs) may lead to object mis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: classification [11,12]. To model rich contextual dependencies over local feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: representations, the first step is to generate a spatial attention matrix, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models spatial relationships between features of any two pixels. In practice, tree-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: like structures always are distributed throughout the biomedical image [13]. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: consequence, we introduce the SAB to encode a wider range of contextual infor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mation into local features, to increase their representative capability.

layout_dets.text: 3 Experiment Results

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The proposed CS-Net was implemented on PyTorch library with a single

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: NVIDIA GPU (GeForce GTX 1080Ti). We choose adaptive moment estima-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion (Adam) optimization. The initial learning rate is set to 0.0001 and a weight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decay of 0.0005. We use poly learning rate policy where the learning rate is mul-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tiplied by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with power 0.9. All training images are rescaled to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 384 × 384. We use the k-fold (k = 4 for STARE; and k = 5 for CCM-1, CCM-2,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and OCT-A) cross-validation method to divide the images. The reported values

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are the mean values across all the folds.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1 Vessel Segmentation in Color Fundus Image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We evaluated the proposed method for retinal blood vessel segmentation on two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: color fundus datasets: DRIVE1 and STARE2. We chose the first manual anno-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation of both datasets as the groundtruth. Figure2 demonstrates the retinal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vessel segmentation performance by applying one of the state-of-the art meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods (named R2U-Net) and the CS-Net. It is clear from visual inspection that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CS-Net achieved better performance than the R2U-Net, as more small vessels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: were extracted from regions of poor contrast.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To facilitate better observation and objective performance evaluation of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proposed method, these metrics were calculated: sensitivity

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: FN), accuracy

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: , and the Area

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Under the ROC Curve (AUC). In addition, the segmentation results were further

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: compared with those of state-of-the-art retinal vessel segmentation algorithms

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and deep learning networks: Bar-COSFIRE (BCOSFIRE) [14], Weighted Sym-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: metry Filter (WSF) [2], DeepVessel [7], U-Net [10], R2U-Net [8], and CE-Net

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [15]. Table 1 shows the proposed CS-Net outperforms all competing methods,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: except for SE in the DRIVE dataset and SP in the STARE dataset, which are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 0.91% and 0.22% lower than those of [15] and [8], respectively. Nevertheless, it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be confirmed that the spatial and channel attention modules are beneficial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for retinal vessel detection in color fundus image.

layout_dets.text: 3.2 Vessel Segmentation in OCT-A Image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We then evaluate the proposed CS-Net on one in-house OCT-A dataset to further

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: validate its segmentation performance. All the 30 OCT-A images were acquired

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: using Heidelberg Spectralis device (Heidelberg, Germany) and all the vessels

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: within the superficial vascular plexus (SVP) were manually traced using an in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: house program written in Matlab (Mathworks R2018, Natwick) by a clinical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: expert as the ground truth.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To our best knowledge, it is the first attempt to use deep learning approach to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extract the vessels for OCT-A image. We compared the proposed network with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: son the vessel segmentation results of the competing methods on an example

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image. Overall, all methods demonstrated similar performance on vessel with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large diameters. The Attention U-Net is able to detect most larger vessels,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: but also falsely enlarges background features where elongated intensity inho-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mogeneities are presented. U-Net misses vessels with small diameters, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leads to a relative lower sensitivity. In contrast to these networks, the proposed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CS-Net integrates local features with global dependencies adaptively, hence, it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrated superior performance in detecting small vessels, indicated by the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: green arrow, and provided relatively higher sensitivity. These findings were also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: confirmed by the evaluation measures reported in Table2: the CS-Net shows this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: superior segmentation performance in terms of all metrics, since it considers the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: attention mechanism to build the association among features.

layout_dets.text: The fiber ground truths of these two datasets were segmented manually by our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To validate the nerve fiber tracing performance, we computed the sensitiv-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity and false discovery rate (FDR) [19] between the predicted centerlines and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: groundtruth. FDR is defined as the fraction of the total of pixels incorrectly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detected as nerve segments over the total of pixels of the traced nerves in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: groundtruth. As customary in the evaluating methods extracting one pixel-wide

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curves [19], a three-pixel tolerance region around the manually traced nerves is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: considered a true positive.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4 Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear structure segmentation is a fundamental step in automated diag-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nosis of many diseases, and it remains a challenging medical image analysis

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: problem despite considerable efforts in research. In this paper, we developed a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: new channel and spatial attention network named CS-Net for curvilinear struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ture segmentation. It considers the attention mechanism to build the associates

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: among features, and aggregate the global contextual information, as thus to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improve the inter-class discrimination and intra-class aggregation abilities by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3 http://bioimlab.dei.unipd.it/.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: http://imed.nimte.ac.cn/.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applying a self-attention mechanism to high level features in the channel and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spatial dimension. Our experimental results show that the proposed method can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: improve the segmentation of curvilinear structure for color fundus, OCT-A and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CCM images. Its superior performance confirms it as a powerful tool for wide

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: healthcare applications and beyond.
